show.description: Gold Digger by Mistake follows Maya, a hardworking girl wrongly labeled a gold digger after a twist of fate ties her to billionaire Arjun. As misunderstandings, class clashes, and hidden truths unfold, Maya must fight to prove her innocence — and figure out whether love can bloom between two people from completely different worlds.
